user.title: Connect Schluter account
user.description: Sign in to your Schluter DITRA-HEAT Wi-Fi account. Thermostat timezones are configured separately after setup.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect Schluter account
reauth_confirm.description: Re-enter the password for the existing Schluter account. This does not change its devices or energy history.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to Schluter. Try again later.
error.invalid_account: Enter a valid account email address.

abort.yaml_active: This integration is already active through YAML. The UI migration is not yet complete; keep using the existing setup.
abort.single_instance_allowed: Only one Schluter account can currently be configured.
abort.already_configured: This Schluter account is already configured.
abort.unique_id_mismatch: Reauthentication must use the account already configured.

init.title: Choose thermostat
init.description: Select the thermostat whose timezone you want to configure.

timezone.title: Set thermostat timezone
timezone.description: Select the IANA timezone for {device_name}. This choice affects the interpretation of future hourly energy reports, so existing history will not be silently remapped.

error.unknown_device: The selected thermostat is no longer available.

abort.devices_unavailable: No thermostat list is available yet. Check the integration connection and try again.
